item.title: Murmur 1.7
item.description:
A real toolbar

The main window has a proper macOS toolbar: a search field that collapses when the window is narrow, the transcribe action, and an overflow menu. What Murmur is doing — listening, transcribing, cleaning up — is now the window's subtitle, where macOS puts that kind of thing, so the content is nothing but your transcripts.

Release notes, here

You're reading them in the app. Every release now carries a summary that shows up in this dialog rather than only on a web page you'd have to go and find.

Under the hood

Murmur's core logic — how a long dictation is stitched back together, the guard that stops a model answering a question you dictated, phrase replacement, version comparison — is now covered by an automated test suite. Nothing you can see, and exactly the sort of thing that keeps what you can see from breaking.
